summary.text: Vanessa Davenport is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 27A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A U.S. Navy veteran who works as an analyst at a Minnesota electric company, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on government accountability, responsible data center growth and reliable, affordable energy.

paragraphs.text: Davenport said in a Ballotpedia survey that she was raised by a single mother in Tennessee and worked three jobs in high school.
She studied aviation and international studies at Jacksonville University and completed FAA air traffic control training.
Her career has included work as a quality assurance auditor for Endeavor Airlines and as a materials manager and heavy equipment operator in industrial construction.
She served on active duty in the U.S. Navy as a logistics specialist aboard the USS Nimitz, then in the Navy Reserves.
Davenport said she is completing a master's degree in engineering while working as an analyst at a Minnesota electric company.

Her stated priorities include campaign finance transparency, requiring large data centers to cover the infrastructure, grid and water costs they create, and reconsidering Minnesota's nuclear moratorium with ratepayer protections.
